CITY COUNCIL MEETING FOR
DECEMBER 7, 2020 AT 12:00 P.M. WILL TAKE PLACE SOLELY BY
VIDEOCONFERENCE/TELECONFERENCE.
In order to facilitate public participation at
meetings held solely by electronic means, the City will accept public comment in
the following manner:
1. Members of the public may submit comments
of any length up to two hours prior to the start of the meeting, at the
following email address:
correspondence@cityofpasadena.net
Please be aware that, while these comments
will be provided to the members of the body and will become part of the
meeting record, they will not be read aloud. Any comment submitted in this
fashion will be forwarded to the legislative body prior to the start of the
meeting.
2. During the meeting, members of the public
may submit up to 200 words regarding items on the agenda, at the following
webpage:
www.cityofpasadena.net/city-clerk/public-comment
If you wish your comments to be read aloud
during the meeting, please indicate so on the form. If you submit more than
one form, only the first one received will be read aloud. The City reserves
the right to summarize comments if necessary for the orderly and timely flow
of the meeting. All comments in their entirety will become part of the
meeting record and will be forwarded to the legislative body.
3. If assistance is needed by phone, please
call the City Clerk�s Office at: (626) 744-4124.

CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  December 7, 2020 - 12:00 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL MEETING
  The virtual meeting was convened pursuant to Executive Order N-29-20 issued by
  Governor Gavin Newsom on March 17, 2020, and was held solely by
  videoconference/teleconference

OPENING:  Mayor Tornek called the special meeting of the City Council to
  order at 12:12 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Terry Tomek
 Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember Victor Gordo
  Councilmember John J. Kennedy
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Margaret McAustin
  Councilmember Andy Wilson

  Staff:  City Manager Steve Mermell
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING The Mayor announced it was time for the Organizational Meeting
  of the City Council.

INVOCATION/PLEDGE OF  Rabbi John Carrier, Pasadena Jewish Temple & Center, led the
ALLEGIANCE  invocation. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Councilmember
  McAustin.

Council Minutes  12/07/2020
   Recorder/County Clerk for the Pasadena General Municipal
  Election, consolidated with the Presidential General Election held
  on November 3, 2020, resulting in the election of Victor M. Gordo
  as Mayor of Pasadena, and the passage of Measure P amending
  the Pasadena City Charter. (Resolution No. 9821)

  Mark Jomsky, City Clerk, summarized the agenda report as part
  of his oral presentation, and responded to questions.

  City Clerk Jomsky read aloud comments expressing appreciation
  for the passing of Measure P, the need to assist homeless
  individuals, and advocating for additional permanent supportive
  housing in the City from the following individuals:

  Sonja K. Berndt, Pasadena resident
  Jackson Loop, Pasadena resident
  Joanne Long, Pasadena resident
  Raquel Calderon, Pasadena resident

  Councilmember Kennedy requested that the closure of the bad
  weather shelters be agenized for discussion at a future City
  Council meeting in support of the public comments that the
  distribution of warm clothing is insufficient to help homeless
  individuals during the cold winter weather.

  Vice Mayor Hampton echoed comments related to helping
  homeless individuals while shelters are closed, and requested an
  emergency City Council meeting be scheduled to address the
  issue.

  In response to Councilmember Kennedy and Vice Mayor
  Hampton's concerns related to the closure of bad weather
  shelters, Mayor Tomek responded that staff is currently looking
  into the matter, but stated that there are complications related to
  the staffing of shelters while meeting pandemic protocols. Steve
  Mermell, City Manager, reported that the Housing Department
  staff has been working on the matter for months trying to identify
  a location for a bad weather shelter, and noted that staff will
  provide additional information on those efforts at a future City
  Council meeting.

  Following discussion, it was moved by Councilmember Wilson,
  seconded by Councilmember McAustin, to approve the staff
  recommendation:

Council Minutes  2  12/07/2020
   AYES:  Councilmembers Gordo, Kennedy, Madison,
  Masuda, McAustin, Wilson, Vice Mayor Hampton,
  Mayor Tomek
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None
  ABSTAIN: None

PRESENTATIONS/  Jonathan Horton, Representative for Congresswoman Judy Chu;
STATEMENTS  Teresa Lamb-Simpson, Field Representative for Congressman
  Adam  Schiff; State Senator Anthony J.  Portantino;
  Assemblymember Chris Holden; Los Angeles County Supervisor
  Katheryn Barger; Bob Miller, 2021 President of the Pasadena
  Tournament of Roses Association; Darryl Dunn, General Manager
  of the Rose Bowl Operating Company; City Manager Steve
  Mermell representing Executive Management staff; Michael
  Warner representing Sister Cities Committee; and Mayor-Elect
  Gordo representing the City Council; all expressed praise and
  gratitude to Mayor Tomek and Councilmember McAustin for their
  many years of dedicated service on the City Council, and
  submitted certificates of recognition and appreciation for their
  contributions to the City and Pasadena residents. They also
  congratulated newly elected Mayor Victor M. Gordo and
  Councilmember Felicia Williams.

  The City Council expressed appreciation and gratitude to Mayor
  Tomek and Councilmember McAustin.

  Mayor T ornek and Councilmember McAustin thanked all the
  speakers, presenters, City Council and staff for their heartfelt
  words, certificates and tokens/gifts of appreciation.

  City Clerk Jomsky read aloud comments from Jacque Robinson,
  Chair of the National Women's Political Caucus - Greater
  Pasadena Area Chapter, recognizing and expressing gratitude to
  Councilmember McAustin for her work and in recognition of her
  leadership with the 1OQ1h Anniversary of Women's Suffrage.

  Councilmember McAustin acknowledged Margo Morales, Field
  Liaison for District 2, for her dedication and expressed
  appreciation for her many years of service to the community.

ADJOURN OUTGOING  It was moved by Councilmember McAustin, seconded by Vice
COUNCIL - SINE DIE  Mayor Hampton, to adjourn this City Council sine die:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Gordo, Kennedy, Madison,
  Masuda, McAustin, Wilson, Vice Mayor Hampton,
  Mayor Tomek
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None
  ABSTAIN: None

Council Minutes  3  12/07/2020
   The meeting was recessed to issue the oath of office to
  Councilmembers Hampton and Williams, and Mayor Gordo.

RECONVENED  Mayor Gordo reconvened the meeting to order at 3:15 p.m.

  City Clerk Jomsky administered the oaths  of office  to
  Councilmembers Madison and Masuda.

  Mayor Gordo representing the City Council presented Vice Mayor
  Hampton with a token in appreciation for his service as the City's
  Vice Mayor. Councilmember Kennedy thanked Mr. Hampton for
  his service as Vice Mayor.

  Tyron Hampton expressed appreciation to his colleagues and the
  City of Pasadena for allowing him to serve as Pasadena's Vice
  Mayor.

  The Mayor opened the floor for nominations for a new Vice Mayor.

  Following discussion it was moved by Councilmember Madison,
  seconded by Councilmember Kennedy, to nominate Andy Wilson
  as Vice Mayor, for a term beginning December 7, 2020 and
  expiring on December 12, 2022. There being no further
  nominations, the Mayor declared the nominations closed, and
  directed the City Clerk to conduct a roll call vote, as follows:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Hampton, Kennedy, Madison,
  Masuda, Williams, Vice Mayor Wilson, Mayor Gordo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None
  ABSTAIN: None

  The Mayor recognized Andy Wilson as the new Vice Mayor and
  introduced the newly constituted Pasadena City Council.

STATEMENTS/CONCLUDING Vice Mayor Wilson acknowledged Councilmember Hampton for
REMARKS  his service as Vice Mayor, and expressed appreciation to his
  colleagues and constituents for their support and assistance.

  Councilmembers Kennedy and Hampton congratulated Mayor
  Gordo as newly elected Mayor and Councilmember Williams as
  District 2 representative.

  Councilmember Kennedy spoke on the killings of three teenagers
  in Pasadena by gang members on Halloween 1993, and the
  recent murder of three men at Villa Parke, which he believes is the
  result of the gang culture in the community; and expressed
  condolences to the families of the victims.

Council Minutes  4  12/07/2020
   Councilmembers Kennedy and Hampton requested that the
  special City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of the
  victims of violence at Villa Parke; and those that have suffered due

  to death and illness caused by COVID-19 in Pasadena, the nation
  and around the world.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 3:49 p.m. in honor of all victims who have lost their
  lives to senseless violence; and all those that are ill, have suffered,
  and may have lost their lives during the COVID-19 pandemic.

  Victor M. Gordo, Mayor
